validated_objective: Release QIF v0.6.40 with an executable, auditable, domain-general policy counterfactual replay lifecycle.
scope: same-evidence deterministic replay of preserved decisions
baseline and counterfactual rule and route reproduction
hypothetical loss-boundary impact records and governance
schema, verifier, example, retained fixtures, plain-language docs, roadmap, AOF evidence, tag, and GitHub release
constraints: No policy optimization, ranking, selection, authorization, or automatic mutation
No conversion of replay counts, route changes, or hypothetical impacts into quality, truth, causality, competence, or authority
No employee surveillance or blame assignment
expected_outcomes: Humans and AI can reproduce what changed under each candidate policy while preserving the original decision and identical evidence.
Uncertain or severe hypothetical loss-boundary effects become explicit governance work before authorization.
